message.content:
The command to publish your portfolio is `wrangler pages deploy public --project-name akira-shirase-oss --branch main`. 

Pushing to GitHub does not directly publish your portfolio. The note indicates that Git push uploads the source to GitHub, but you need to build your site locally with Zola and then use Wrangler CLI to deploy the built `public` directory to publish your portfolio.

final_answer:
The command to publish your portfolio is `wrangler pages deploy public --project-name akira-shirase-oss --branch main`. 

Pushing to GitHub does not directly publish your portfolio. The note indicates that Git push uploads the source to GitHub, but you need to build your site locally with Zola and then use Wrangler CLI to deploy the built `public` directory to publish your portfolio.
